standard.summary: 概念编辑时间步课程每个循环划分的 band 数量。默认 10，范围 2~50。
standard.effect: band 越多每个 band 越窄、单步监督越集中，但完成一轮完整覆盖需要的步数越多；非整数输入会告警并回落默认 10。
standard.whenToUse: 总步数多（≥500）可以用更细的 band（15~20）获得更平滑的课程；短训练用较粗的 band（5~8）保证覆盖完整。
standard.avoidWhen: concept_edit_timestep_curriculum 关闭时无效；band 数超过总步数除以合理循环次数时部分 band 只被访问一两次，课程失去意义。

standard_en.summary: How many bands each cycle of the concept-edit timestep curriculum is divided into. Default 10, range 2-50.
standard_en.effect: More bands mean narrower bands and more concentrated supervision per step, but a full sweep takes more steps. A non-integer input warns and falls back to the default of 10.
standard_en.whenToUse: With plenty of steps (>=500) finer bands (15-20) give a smoother curriculum; short runs want coarser bands (5-8) so coverage completes.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It has no effect when concept_edit_timestep_curriculum is off, and once the band count exceeds the step count divided by a sensible number of cycles, some bands are visited only once or twice and the curriculum loses its point.

advanced.principle: band 宽度 = 时间步窗口 / band 数。窄 band 使批内与批间的 timestep 方差都更小（梯度更一致），但课程周期变长；band 数是「梯度一致性 ↔ 覆盖速度」的调节旋钮。
advanced.intervention: concept_edit_curriculum.py：解析 band 数（异常输入 warning + 回落 10），据此计算每步所属 band 与其 timestep 范围。
advanced.expectedImpact: 细 band 下 loss 锯齿更细密、编辑方向更纯；粗 band 接近关闭课程的行为。
advanced.tradeoffs: 建议 band 数 × 每 band 期望步数 ≤ 总步数，否则最后的 band 训练不足。

advanced_en.principle: Band width = timestep window / band count. Narrow bands lower both intra- and inter-batch timestep variance (more consistent gradients) but lengthen the curriculum cycle; the band count is the knob between "gradient consistency ↔ coverage speed".
advanced_en.intervention: concept_edit_curriculum.py: parses the band count (warning + fallback to 10 on bad input) and derives each step's band and its timestep range.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Fine bands give finer loss sawtooth and purer edit direction; coarse bands approach curriculum-off behavior.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Aim for band count × expected steps per band ≤ total steps, otherwise the final bands are under-trained.
